decisions.reason: The online customer portal supports the firm's core display and packaging business, and as a service layer it lets the firm learn from customer interactions, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.
The packaging display solution builds directly on the firm's cardboard converting know-how, and the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024 is clear external validation it can build on.

The quarter-pallet pegboard display is a close extension of existing display competencies with its own web page, though catalogue variants like this are sometimes rotated out, as happened with Product A.
The small counter display uses well-understood cardboard design and production knowledge, so the firm can interpret customer feedback and refine it cheaply.
The large freestanding information display fits the firm's display know-how, but it serves a narrower use, which carries some risk of portfolio pruning.
